race.comment: Tough finish. SOMEWHERE (6) doesn't know how to run a bad race but was turned over as the $1.40 favourite in the Donald Cup last start, albeit beaten a nose and they gapped third. He gets every chance from the gate and handles all ground so doubt he's far away again. WETUMPKA (17) was game in the Country Final behind Sulek last start which is solid form for this. He's racing very well and likes heavy ground. OPTIONS (9) was strong the line fresh over this trip at Flemington and while he's drawn sticky, if the pace is genuine he can cause a late scare. STAY HUMBLE (19) is our likely leader and should give a bold sight with Jabez back in the saddle.
